review_output: {"summary":"I re-checked all five prior findings against the supplied code. Two are resolved, one is resolved in code but not yet measured, and two NITs remain open. No new BLOCKER and no new confirmed correctness defect. (1) MAJOR, contention gate: still open. It fails 7/20, is not waived, and no code here addresses it. (2) MINOR, lock hold: resolved in code, performance not verified. The shape, key, string/number type, duplicate and integer-range checks now run before any lock. Membership is one jsonb_to_recordset LEFT JOIN with WHERE g.id IS NULL, and expiry is checked again just before the INSERT. Still missing: a 1M-fact publish timing run (NOT_RUN), and a rerun of the lock-timeout (55P03) test, which passed before the SQL was reordered. (3) MINOR, metadata detoast: resolved. rowCount is now a column, a CHECK keeps it equal to jsonb_array_length(rows), the reader selects only p.\"rowCount\", and the probe confirms a mismatched UPDATE is rejected. (4) NIT, isolation check: still open, because the isolation check still runs only after `if (!record) return`. (5) NIT, payload query predicates: partly fixed. The test now asserts a single query and no 'SELECT rows', but the payload query still filters only on reportId. Per-person in-place dedup in the worker: correct. The comparator covers all four fields, sorting and dedup act only on worker-built arrays (inputs are not mutated), the segment budget is counted after dedup as documented, and subtraction is safe within the timestamp bounds. The worker's half-open window [verifiedAt, endMs-1] matches the anti-join's [verifiedAt, windowEndAt). Open items outside this code: the trusted coverage producer and deployed scheduling are unfinished, and the large DB publish is NOT_RUN.
